-- Check if partnerorgs can be NULL or empty
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       COUNT(partnerorgs) as non_null,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN partnerorgs IS NULL OR partnerorgs = '' THEN 1 END) as null_or_empty
FROM coordinationandevaluation;

-- Test the coordination score calculation
SELECT coordevalregistry, coorddistref, coordopsref, partnerorgs, coordeffectlvl,
       CASE 
           WHEN coordeffectlvl = 'High' THEN 3
           WHEN coordeffectlvl = 'Medium' THEN 2
           ELSE 1
       END as effect_factor,
       -- Split by ';' and count, then divide by 10, multiply by factor
       (array_length(string_to_array(partnerorgs, ';'), 1)::numeric / 10.0) * 
       CASE 
           WHEN coordeffectlvl = 'High' THEN 3
           WHEN coordeffectlvl = 'Medium' THEN 2
           ELSE 1
       END as caci_score
FROM coordinationandevaluation LIMIT 5;
